post.description: Requires the same runtime-agent token, exact cluster and active attempt. A report_ingested result carries the kube-bench JSON object and SHA-256 of its compact JSON bytes (Go json.Compact, not key sorting), bounded to 16 MiB. The envelope is bounded to 16 MiB plus 64 KiB. The server validates source controls and parses evidence with the request benchmark. Evidence, attempt, request and audit commit atomically. FAIL controls remain a valid completed scan. An identical terminal outcome and digest returns the prior receipt without refreshing evidence or audit; a different result conflicts. Bounded failure outcomes carry no report, digest or raw stderr.

get.description: Organization-scoped finding instances. Vulnerability rows targeted at workloads are excluded to avoid duplicate image findings.
